cohort: Thirty-nine women recruited at term-scheduled Caesarean section, grouped by pre-gravid BMI (<25 kg/m2 and >30 kg/m2).
finding: Placental TLR4, IL6, and IL8 expression was significantly increased in obese women compared to lean women, and placental TLR4 expression positively correlated with maternal pre-gravid BMI, insulin resistance index, plasma insulin, and C-reactive protein.
gest_age: Term (samples obtained at term-scheduled Caesarean section)
